# Finite-Candidate Rollouts and Q_H {#rl-planning-theory}

This page is navigation and external background only. The finite-candidate
rollout, state/action notation, $Q_H$ equations, data schema, and acceptance
checks are canonical in the [Typst thesis](../../typst/thesis/main.typ),
its method and experimental-design sections, and the Python docstrings/tests
that implement them. The development roadmap records readiness and gates only.

The literature rationale for discrete candidate rollouts is collected in
[RL sources for rollout and Q_H](../literature/rl_planning.qmd). Candidate
sampling context is retained in [candidate sampling](candidate_sampling_target_selection.qmd).
Those pages must not be read as normative ARIA-NBV contracts.
